# Adler32

The Adler-32 of a message, computed a batch of bytes at a time.

```rux
pub struct Adler32 {
    // private fields
}
```

`Copy`, holding only the two sums, so passing one by value takes a snapshot of the checksum so far.

## Constructors

<h3 id="new"><code>Adler32</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Adler32() -> Adler32
```

Constructs a checksum with nothing written into it yet.

**Returns**: a hasher with nothing written to it yet

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/Adler.rux#L23)

## Methods

<h3 id="reset"><code>Reset</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Reset(self: &var Adler32)
```

Puts the checksum back to where [`Adler32()`](/docs/api/hash/adler32) leaves one. Everything written so far is forgotten.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/Adler.rux#L29)

<h3 id="value"><code>Value</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Value(self: &Adler32) -> uint32
```

The checksum of everything written so far: the second sum in the high half and the first in the low half.
Writing more continues from here rather than starting over.

**Returns**: the checksum

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/Adler.rux#L38)

## Implements Hasher

`Adler32` conforms to [`Hasher`](/docs/api/hash/hasher).

<h3 id="write"><code>Write</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Write(
    self: &var Adler32,
    bytes: *byte,
    length: uint
)
```

Adds `length` bytes at `bytes` to the checksum. A zero length changes nothing and is the one case in which
`bytes` may be null. Splitting a message across several writes gives the same answer as one write.
Runs in time proportional to `length` and allocates nothing.

| Name     | Type    | Description                          |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `bytes`  | `*byte` | the bytes to absorb                  |
| `length` | `uint`  | how many bytes; zero absorbs nothing |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/Adler.rux#L50)

<h3 id="finish"><code>Finish</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Finish(self: &var Adler32) -> uint64
```

The checksum of everything written so far, widened to 64 bits; the upper half is always zero.

**Returns**: the checksum

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Hash/Src/Adler.rux#L73)
